_comment: SSOT for doctor check #56 (dead permission rules). Claude Code's file-permission matcher only consults Edit(path) and Read(path) rules; a path-form rule naming any other file tool is accepted by the settings schema, produces a startup warning, and grants/denies nothing. Each entry below is a tool name that Claude Code itself rewrites in that warning. Adding a newly-discovered dead form must be an edit to THIS FILE ONLY — check-dead-permission-rules.cjs hardcodes no tool names.

_verifiedAgainst.method: Read the shipped rule validator out of the installed binary (~/.local/share/claude/versions/2.1.228). The validator maps toolName -> replacement verbatim: Write|NotebookEdit|MultiEdit -> Edit, Glob -> Read, and emits the warning only when the rule has parenthesised content that does not contain ':*'. Nothing here is inferred from the warning text alone.
_verifiedAgainst.howToRecheck: strings <claude-binary> | grep 'not matched by file permission checks' and read the surrounding validator branch; update pathRuleRewrites if the map changed.
